jobs.title: Cloud Engineer Automation
jobs.desc:
Working for a company like Smile Digital Health means supporting our mandate for #BetterGlobalHealth . We strive towards this goal every day, and the results can be seen in the impact of our innovative health data platform and data management solutions, which are used in over 20 countries. We were #19 on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 Ranking for 2024! Smile Digital Health makes it easy for healthcare stakeholders to collect and exchange data with our leading FHIR-based data liberation platform. At its heart, the Smile platform enables people and organizations to better manage healthcare data. We help generate and liberate structured healthcare data to ensure effective delivery across care teams and health systems bringing #BetterGlobalHealth to patients everyday! Apply today and find plenty of reasons to SMILE! The Cloud Engineer (Automation) is responsible for designing, building, operating and improving production-grade automation for Smile Digital Health, its clients and partners. This role will be responsible for the pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and recovery procedures, that the platform runs on. This Engineer will merge direct platform engineering expertise with driving strategic changes in how the department designs, deploys, and maintains its infrastructure. Key responsibilities include managing build and release engineering, orchestrating the Terraform and Helm infrastructure, provisioning on-demand environments, and implementing automated recovery. This role works closely with Platform Engineering, Solution Engineering, Service Operations and Engineering Practice QA to remove unnecessary repetitive, manual work and effectively optimize a build from the time the client commits to a running environment faster, decrease platform costs, and utilize AI to enhance the platformâs engineering and operations. 
 Responsibilities: Own build and release engineering by reviewing the current repositories and CI setup, then consolidate duplicated Azure DevOps pipeline YAML onto shared reusable templates with change detection and automated quality gates. Identify and eliminate manual efforts for cross-functional teams and replace them with scheduled, auditable automation. For example, automating patching, certificate and secret rotation, environment scaling, and recurring reports Implement GitOps-based continuous delivery - declarative, Git-driven deployments with automated reconciliation, drift detection and rollback. Automate line-of-business environments end to end, provisioned and torn down on demand across every Azure service and application involved. Automate business continuity and disaster recovery through backup validation, restore and failover, recurring DR drills, and measured RTO and RPO. Ensure Helm and Terraform are easy to upgrade by charting reuse and configuration validation, versioned modules, and state boundaries that limit how far an upgrade reaches. Run in-cluster platform services deployed through Helm, harden workloads for availability and capacity: health probes, replica counts, and right-sized requests, limits and autoscaling. Ensure that the Terraform configuration is regularly maintained. Build and maintain Build Agent images for streamlining tooling available for the builds. Automate the guardrails such as policy-as-code, security and IaC scanning in the pipeline, and alerts and dashboards defined as code. Implement AI-assisted engineering in the platform teamâs day-to-day work Contribute to the departmentâs AI enablement, package knowledge into reusable skills and runbooks in the shared skill library. Work with the development and operations teams to find automation gaps, prioritize them, and close them. Troubleshoot production and staging issues and document what you automate so others can operate it. Requirements: 6+ years of hands-on cloud engineering, DevOps and/or platform engineering experience, including at least 1-2+ years with infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation on Microsoft Azure in production. Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar and/or equivalent work experience. Practical in-depth knowledge and expertise in Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps pipelines, and GitOps delivery (Argo CD or Flux). Strong Terraform skills including, but not limited to, experience with module design, provider version management, state management and refactoring. Expertise in Helm chart authoring and refactoring, including recent experience with Kubernetes and AKS. Demonstrated knowledge across Azure (AKS, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, networking, identity) and observability as code (Azure Monitor and/or Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry). Hands-on experience automating backup, restore and failover with measured RTO and RPO. Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent), keeping confidential data out of them and reviewing what they produce. Hands-on experience running, hardening and right-sizing production workloads on Kubernetes Hands-on Kafka operations: topic and partition design, consumer group sizing, and throughput and latency trade-offs. Experience migrating between Kafka platforms (HDInsight, Confluent, MSK or self-managed) is a strong asset. Strong Python and Bash skills, able to build maintainable tooling, not glue scripts. A demonstrable record of replacing manual processes with automation. FinOps practice and Azure Cost Management, an asset. Regulated environment experience (healthcare, PHI), an asset. Certifications: HashiCorp Terraform Associate; Microsoft AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305; CKA or CKAD, an asset. Observability as code with Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry; Azure cost optimization, an asset. 
 $120,000 - $140,000 a year 
 Smile discloses that artificial intelligence (AI) may be used in portions of the recruitment and selection process, such as resume screening or application assessment. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by qualified human decision-makers, and AI tools are used to support â not replace â fair and equitable hiring practices. This position is a new role, created to support Smileâs continued growth and commitment to operational excellence. Some of the benefits we offer: * Remote Work Environment * Flexible Time Away From Work Policy including PTO, Personal and Sick Days * Competitive Salary and Health/Medical Benefits * RRSP/TFSA/401K Employee Contribution * Life and Disability * Employee Assistance Program * FHIR Study Program and Skillsoft Learning * Super HAPI Fun Club Smile's core values include respect, inclusion, embracing our differences, and celebrating shared values because our people are the foundation of our success. We are big on creating a sense of belonging and empowering each other to bring our authentic selves to work. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that values diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Candidates are encouraged to inform us if they wish to discuss or require accommodations during interviews or while working at Smile. jobs.title: Director, Commissioning, EMEA
jobs.desc: Director, Commissioning, EMEA Role Summary The Commissioning Director, EMEA will lead commissioning across STACK data centre projects, from early project engagement through testing, validation and final power and facilities handover. This role provides programme-level leadership for the planning, development and consistent execution of commissioning activities across mission-critical facilities, ensuring systems perform safely, reliably and in line with design intent and client requirements. Working across engineering, construction, operations and external commissioning partners, you will set and maintain commissioning standards, oversee test strategies and documentation, and provide clear visibility of progress, risk and readiness across the EMEA portfolio. Key Responsibilities · Lead the development and execution of commissioning plans across STACK EMEA projects, including all commissioning levels through Integrated Systems Testing and handover. · Develop, standardise and review commissioning documentation, including Functional Performance Tests, Factory Acceptance Tests, equipment start-up procedures, installation checklists, test protocols, scripts and methods. · Ensure commissioning documentation and activities align with project design, specifications, Basis of Design and Owner’s Project Requirements. · Provide programme-level oversight of multi-discipline pre-commissioning and commissioning activities across critical infrastructure construction and special projects. · Coordinate with project teams, client engineers and technical stakeholders to assess issues identified during testing, determine criticality and drive appropriate resolution. · Oversee QA/QC of pre-functional and functional test results, ensuring completeness, accuracy and appropriate interpretation of results. · Provide commissioning input into project design, planning and schedules, identifying risks, dependencies and potential constraints early. · Ensure commissioning activities comply with applicable safety, environmental, quality and technical standards, and actively support STACK safety programmes. · Manage and coordinate commissioning agents and subcontractors on site, escalating issues or potential blockers that could affect project delivery. · Track commissioning progress against key delivery milestones and provide programme reporting, metrics and data-driven insight to stakeholders. · Partner with Procurement, Legal, Finance and other functions to develop effective cross-functional processes and resolve delivery gaps. · Manage commissioning budgets and support effective commercial oversight of commissioning activities. What You’ll Bring · Demonstrable commissioning leadership experience within data centres or other mission-critical environments, with strong experience managing complex mechanical and electrical commissioning programmes. · A qualification in Electrical, Mechanical, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. · Strong technical knowledge of mechanical and electrical plant and services supporting mission-critical Data Centre environments, including MV/LV distribution switchgear, automatic transfer schemes, standby generators, UPS, chillers, CRAC/CRAH systems, ancillary cooling plant, BMS and automation/monitoring systems. · Advanced understanding of mechanical and/or electrical systems commissioning, controls and design principles. · Ability to read and interpret construction and technical documentation, including electrical and mechanical schematics, control diagrams, specifications and design drawings. · Knowledge of Data Centre and mission-critical design concepts, commissioning standards and safety requirements. · Experience developing and reviewing test scripts and protocols that validate design intent and operational performance. · Commercial awareness, including budget management, contracting considerations, programme reporting and performance metrics. · Strong communication, stakeholder management and negotiation skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, delivery, operations, clients and external partners. · Comfort working across multiple projects and countries, with the ability to travel to EMEA project and installation sites as required (approximately 20%). What We Offer · The opportunity to play a key role in delivering critical digital infrastructure across EMEA. · The chance to build your career with STACK in a fast-growing, international Data Centre business. · Competitive compensation and benefits designed to support you both professionally and personally. About STACK Infrastructure STACK Infrastructure is a global digital infrastructure partner to the world’s most innovative companies. We develop, build and operate Data Centres designed to meet the scale, performance and sustainability requirements of today’s leading technology businesses. Across EMEA, our teams work together to deliver resilient, high-quality infrastructure and create long-term value for our customers and communities. jobs.desc: Job Title: Full Stack Software Engineer Type: Full-time Location: Paris What about us? Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas. At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents. By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide. Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀 The Role We are hiring a Full Stack Software Engineer to drive our product development cycle. This role is built on the philosophy that the best engineers don't just write code, they build solutions. Your primary responsibility is to bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution, rapidly translating high-level goals into polished, shipped features. You will be expected to challenge requirements , bring a product-first mindset to the engineering team, and ensure every line of code adds tangible value. This role demands strong software engineering proficiency and acute product judgment to prioritize and ship high-impact features in a fast-paced environment. What do you need to be successful in this role? Exceptional software engineering and system design capability , with proven experience designing, building, and shipping production-grade, scalable systems across the full stack (including C#, Python, and Typescript proficiency), always prioritizing technical clarity and maintainable architecture. A "Product-First" Engineering Mindset , demonstrating the ability to analyze business needs and challenge assumptions. You don't just build what is asked; you build what is needed to move the needle for the product and the user. End-to-end feature ownership , driving the entire development lifecycle from defining requirements to robust implementation, QA, deployment and monitoring, maintaining high accountability for the final user and business outcome. Strategic communication skills , capable of seamlessly translating deep technical concepts for business stakeholders and, conversely, translating complex business objectives into prioritized, elegant engineering solutions. High-velocity development , leveraging modern developer tools (such as agentic coding or advanced automation techniques) to achieve accelerated delivery while rigorously upholding code quality and architectural integrity. Inspiring Mission : We are dedicated to revolutionizing business financing and making a positive impact on the European economy. Your work at INFINIT will have a lasting effect on businesses and communities. Flexible Benefits: Access Flexible Retribution benefits with Swile through a convenient mobile app Health and Well-being: Your health matters to us. You will have access to top-quality Medical Mental Health Insurance and corporate gym discounts. Quality Time Together : We foster a sense of community with annual gatherings and bi-weekly office team gatherings. You're more than welcome to join us for quality time. Personal Time Off : Enjoy flexibility with your personal time off as well as your birthday off. Flexibility and Ownership : We trust our team and we are goal-oriented. Enjoy the flexibility of hybrid working 3 days a week in our Paris office and 2 days at home. Diversity and Inclusion INFINIT promotes an inclusive culture that seeks equity and values different perspectives. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.
